title: Signage development examples
slide_intent: Teach designers how to establish a gallery entrance with a name readable from below while preserving a smaller institutional signature.
strategic_value: Millennium Gallery can lead in its own color and lettering while the circular seal connects it to Sheffield Museums.
demonstration: One suspended pink sign fills a single architectural photograph. The large white venue mark occupies the center and the smaller seal sits to the right.
practical_value: Use the venue mark as the main read on an entrance sign and check that the parent seal remains distinct at the edge.

content_islands.name: Entrance photograph
content_islands.spec: Center a large photograph of the hanging sign beneath the heading. Leave the suspension and glass entrance visible.

content_islands.name: Sign face
content_islands.spec: Place the white framed Millennium Gallery mark on pink. Separate the smaller Sheffield Museums seal toward the lower right.
